author: Judy Vianest-Piccolomini
text: Fight for it!  Have your doctor fight for it for you!  If you are taking insulin, you need to know your blood glucose numbers so you don't have an episide of hypoglycemia.  This is not to scare you.  This is to help you fight for what you deserve from your health  insurance company.  Good luck.
